summary: Short junction kerb, very steep, no stopping, houses within 10-11m.

best_section.where: Prospect Terrace south kerb at the corner, beside the corner house

drivers.seclusion: A detached house 10m and an apartment block 11m from the kerb on its own side; Lusso Residences 19m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Corner kerb with a few cars parked nearby, but the stretch is only 20m and sits at a junction.
drivers.traffic: Junction beside a main road; turning traffic.

sun_shade: Open to the sun; trees on the west side give some afternoon shade.
